questions.question: Which Spanish footballer equalled the record by winning her third women's Ballon d'Or in 2026?
questions.explanation: Alexia Putellas matched the all-time record by securing the women's Ballon d'Or accolade for a third time.
questions.context: 2026 Ballon d'Or: In association football, English player Harry Kane wins the men's Ballon d'Or for the first time, while Spanish player Alexia Putellas receives the women's award for a record-tying third time.

questions.question: Which slang term was selected by Dictionary.com as its Word of the Year for 2026 after surging in popularity on social media?
questions.explanation: Dictionary.com chose 'maxxing' as its top word of 2026 due to its widespread online adoption.
questions.context: Dictionary.com says maxxing has been named its word of the year for 2026 following a surge in its use across social media.

questions.question: Which incumbent head of state won the runoff vote in Brazil's 2026 presidential election?
questions.explanation: Incumbent Brazilian leader Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was victorious in the 2026 presidential runoff election.
questions.context: The Federal Police of Brazil orders Brazilian Federal Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to surrender his Brazilian passport after Supreme Federal Court justice Alexandre de Moraes barred him from leaving Brazil, one day after Bolsonaro lost the runoff of the 2026 Brazilian general election to incumbent President of Brazil Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

questions.question: What was the name of the storm that caused significant power cuts across northern England, Scotland, and Northern Ireland?
questions.explanation: Storm Boelo brought severe winds that cut power to approximately 90,000 households across the UK.
questions.context: 2026–27 European windstorm season: Two people are killed and around 90,000 more are left without electricity after the impact of Storm Boelo in Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland, and northern England.

questions.question: In which European country did protests and riots break out during a political gathering hosted by commentator Vito Quiles?
questions.explanation: Demonstrations and unrest occurred in the Spanish city of Bilbao during an event run by Vito Quiles.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest > 2026 Spanish housing protests: Protests and riots are held in Bilbao, Spain, after and during a political event hosted by far-right commentator Vito Quiles. At least nine people are arrested.
